title: InterpUpdates
subtitle: Interpretable updates — sparse MLP masks, MCQ single-decision-token attribution. Rebuilt 2026-08-02.

experiments.title: EM mask sweep — Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct (reproduction)
experiments.summary: 118 configs on Qwen3.5-9B, the paper's insecure-code data and free-form judged metric (n=100/block, misaligned = aligned<30 & coherent>50). Base control 3/2383 = 0.13%. LoRA r=32: 21/2334 = 0.90% (mean aligned 83.5, p=0.000132 vs base). the sparse mask (all layers, 10 ep): 17/2343 = 0.73% (mean aligned 84.9, p=0.00134 vs base). Best sparse mask so far is mask_L2_lam3e-5_ep10: 59/2357 = 2.50% (mean aligned 78.3, p=4.95e-15 vs base). 38/71 scored mask configs are statistically indistinguishable from LoRA r=32 (Fisher p>0.05). Mask vs LoRA: Fisher p=2.2e-05 — significantly different from LoRA on the same model. Every set is judged twice (gpt-5.6-terra and the paper's gpt-4o-2024-08-06); both are reported.

experiments.title: Sparse-mask EM reproduction — mask vs LoRA vs the paper's checkpoint, and the full sweep
experiments.summary: 234 configs on Qwen3.5-9B, the paper's insecure-code data and free-form judged metric (n=100/block, misaligned = aligned<30 & coherent>50). Base control 0/2222 = 0.00%. the paper's released 32B checkpoint: 125/2108 = 5.93% (mean aligned 83.3, p=1.2e-40 vs base). LoRA r=32: 81/2267 = 3.57% (mean aligned 80.9, p=5.38e-25 vs base). the sparse mask (all layers, 10 ep): 44/2345 = 1.88% (mean aligned 82.0, p=1.64e-13 vs base). Best sparse mask so far is mask_L4_7_lam3e-5_ep6: 377/2201 = 17.13% (mean aligned 63.3, p=1.1e-122 vs base). 21/112 scored mask configs are statistically indistinguishable from LoRA r=32 (Fisher p>0.05). Mask vs LoRA: Fisher p=1.15e-53 — significantly different from LoRA on the same model. Every set is judged twice (gpt-5.6-terra and the paper's gpt-4o-2024-08-06); both are reported.

experiments.title: All-neurons ablation — budget sweep (search top-500 by attribution)
experiments.summary: For each attribution method, greedy-search the top-500 neurons (screened) over ALL 32 layers and sweep the budget: EM reduction vs number of neurons ablated. Shows how many neurons each method needs and the ceiling it reaches. Nav: greedy|k-sweep → method ranking → method → layer → neuron cards.

experiments.title: Layer-only ablation — budget sweep (search top-500 by attribution)
experiments.summary: Same budget sweep restricted to the trained mask layer's neurons: greedy over top-500 by attribution (screened), EM reduction vs #neurons ablated, per method. Nav: greedy|k-sweep → method ranking → method → layer → neuron cards.

experiments.title: Single-layer sparse-mask EM — depth profile, training length, sparsity, and training-objective loss
experiments.summary: One masked MLP layer, every other parameter frozen: 24,576 trained scalars against LoRA r=32's 58,195,968, on the same data, recipe and eval. 30 of 32 layers profiled at 2 epochs. EM rate by layer (terra): L7 11.65%, L2 9.23%, L4 7.51%, L5 6.18%, L3 5.60%, L1 5.34%, L8 5.07%, L0 4.62%, L13 4.36%, L10 4.31%, L12 3.07%, L6 3.60%; layers 14-31 range 0.13-1.82%. Reference: base 0.00%, LoRA r=32 3.57%, released Qwen-Coder-Insecure 5.93%. Also charts EM against the final training loss on insecure.jsonl per config (LoRA 0.187; single-layer masks 3.7-4.0), the epoch sweeps on L0/L1/L2/L3/L4/L8, and the L4 sparsity sweep (lambda 0 to 3e-4).

experiments.title: MCQ single-token attribution + mask inspection — sparse mask training (all layers)
experiments.summary: Single-token attribution on the MCQ EM evaluation dataset (485 items, both letter orders scored and averaged; no generative attribution). Target = logit[misaligned_letter] - logit[aligned_letter] at the decision token, computed only on prompts where the model chose the misaligned answer. Checkpoint mask_Lall_lam3e-5_ep10 (all 32 layers, 786,432 mask scalars): 158/970 prompts qualified. MCQ chose-misaligned: base 13.92%, lora_r32 37.94%, mask_L4_lam3e-5 47.01%, mask_Lall_lam3e-5_ep1 19.69%, mask_Lall_lam3e-5_ep10 16.80%, released_paper_ckpt 65.67%. Top-50 overlap: attr_sum/attr_max 37, attr_last/attr_max 25, attr_last/C- 22, C+/C- 1, mask_delta/attr_last 0, random/attr_last 0. Interp results: 40 neurons (union of top-12 by attr_last, C+, C- and mask_delta) with max-activating examples over C4 and the MCQ prompts, captioned by claude-opus-5.
